events.title: Data Diplomats AI Workshop for Nonprofits (Intermediate Level)

landing.title: From burnout
landing.lead: Your team is stretched thin. AI can give your executive director their time back, and our hands-on workshops show you how.

pains.title: Grant applications
pains.pain: Narratives, budgets and reports, rewritten for every funder.
pains.fix: AI grant writing: draft and tailor applications and watch for new opportunities.

pains.title: Volunteer management
pains.pain: Scheduling, onboarding and thank-yous eat the week.
pains.fix: Volunteer management automation for reminders, onboarding and updates.

pains.title: Social services
pains.pain: Intake, case notes and reporting pull staff away from clients.
pains.fix: AI for case notes and reporting, with a person reviewing every result.

pains.title: Fundraising campaigns
pains.pain: Appeals, newsletters and donor thank-yous never stop.
pains.fix: Fundraising automation that drafts campaigns in your voice for review.

burnout.label: It all lands on one person
burnout.title: Executive director burnout
burnout.stat: 89% of nonprofit CEOs surveyed say they are concerned about their own burnout.
burnout.sourceLabel: Foundation Source, on a February 2026 survey of 887 foundation-funded nonprofit leaders

solution.label: The fix
solution.title: Hands-on AI training for nonprofits
solution.body: Build real workflows for meeting notes, grant monitoring, social media and volunteer communication, with your own organization in mind.
